title: Recommendations of Ehraam till halting at Arafah
categoryChain: Recommendations of Ehraam till halting at Arafah
introduction:
RECOMMENDATIONS OF EHRAAM TILL HALTING AT ARFAAT

The recommendations of Ehraam of Hajj are recommended in Hajj-e-Tamatto also when a pilgrim comes out of Mecca wearing Ehraam, he should at once say LABBAYK on seeing ABTAH in a loud voice and on seeing Mina he should say:

One should walk with a peaceful heart with dignity praising and glorifying Allah and upon reaching Mina say:

Then say:

It is recommended to stay at Mina on Arafah night and be engrossed in Allah's obedience. It is better to recite invocations and especially the prayers in Masjid-e-Khayf. Recite the Taqeebat till sunrise after the morning prayers and then go to Arafaat. One can go even after sunrise but it is recommended not to pass from Mashar' before sunrise. One should reicte the following facing Arafaat:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِیَّاكَ اَرْجُوْ وَ اِیَّاكَ اَدْعُوْ فَبَلِّغْنِیْ اَمَلِیْ وَ اَصْلِحْ لِیْ عَمَلِیْ۔
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ اَقْدَمَنِیْهَا صَالِحًا فِی عَافِیَۃٍ وَ بَلَّغَنِیْ هٰذَا الْمَكَانِ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهٖ مِنٰی وَ هِیَ مِمَّا مَنَنْتَ بِهٖ عَلَیْنَا مِنَ الْمَنَاسِكِ فَاَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَیَّ بِمَا مَنَنْتَ عَلٰی اَنْبِیَآئِكَ فَاِنَّمَا اَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَ فِیْ قَبْضَتِكَ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِلَیْكَ صَمَدْتُ وَ اِیَّاكَ اعْتَمَدْتُ وَ وَجْهَكَ اَرَدْتُ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُبَارِكَ لِیْ فِیْ رِحْلَتِیْ وَ اَنْ تَقْضِیَ لِیْ حَاجَتِیْ وَ اَنْ تَجْعَلَنِیْ مِمَّنْ تُبَاهِیْ بِهِ الْیَوْمَ مَنْ هُوَ اَفْضَلُ مِنِّیْ۔
